subject: Amendment required for draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference, and noted a few discrepancies that require correction.

Specifically, the Consignee is listed as UAB NOVAKOPA on the draft Bill of Lading, whereas the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC.

Additionally, the Notify Party is listed as UAB NOVAKOPA on the draft Bill of Lading, but the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC.

Please amend the draft Bill of Lading so that it matches the Shipping Instruction.

Best regards,
Shipping Operations
